raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

`QuantizerRole`, `QuantizerRequest`, and `DelayedScalingRequest` are plain dataclasses, but they were defined in `quantization.py`. Since `HybridQuantizer.__init__` needs `QuantizerRequest`, the `tensor` package had to import it lazily from inside a method, and `quantization.py` compensated with five deferred quantizer imports in `RecipeState.make_quantizers()` (`Float8Quantizer`, `Float8CurrentScalingQuantizer`, `MXFP8Quantizer`, `Float8BlockQuantizer`, `NVFP4Quantizer`). Three of those carry `TODO(ksivamani)` notes asking for a better design. The lazy imports date back to TE 2.0, where the `tensor` package genuinely imported `fp8`; that back-edge is long gone, and this PR removes what it left behind.

Fixes: no tracking issue — resolves the `TODO(ksivamani)` notes in `transformer_engine/pytorch/quantization.py`.

## Type of change

- [x] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Add `transformer_engine/pytorch/quantizer_types.py`, a leaf module containing `QuantizerRole`, `QuantizerRequest`, and `DelayedScalingRequest` (definitions unchanged). It imports nothing from the rest of `transformer_engine.pytorch`.
- `quantization.py`: import and re-export the three dataclasses from the new module (still listed in `__all__`), hoist the five deferred quantizer imports to module level, and drop the now-unused `import dataclasses`.
- `tensor/hybrid_tensor.py`, `custom_recipes/quantizer_factories.py`, `custom_recipes/quantizer_factory_zoo.py`: import the dataclasses from the leaf module; no more local imports of `quantization`.
- Backward compatible: `transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization.QuantizerRole` and friends still resolve, so user code, docs (autoapi), and old pickles are unaffected.
- The tensor-package imports in `quantization.py` are placed before `from .utils import ...`, with a comment: `.utils` pulls in `quantized_tensor` (via the debug tooling), which imports a helper from inside `tensor/`, so the `tensor` package must be initializing for that import to succeed. This removes the reliance on the current import order within the package.

No behavior change; pure import restructuring.

## Testing

- `black` (24.4.2, repo settings) and `pylint` (3.3.1, repo `pylintrc`) on all touched files: no new warnings.
- Static import-graph check: `transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor` no longer reaches `quantization` at module level, and no new cycles are introduced.
- `python -c "import transformer_engine.pytorch"`
- `python -c "import transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization"`
- `pytest tests/pytorch/test_custom_recipe.py`

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

+# Copyright (c) 2022-2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+
+"""Lightweight types shared by the quantization recipe machinery and quantizers.
+
+The classes in this module are plain dataclasses with no dependencies on the
+rest of ``transformer_engine.pytorch``. They live here, rather than in
+``quantization.py``, so that both :mod:`transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization`
+and the ``transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor`` package can import them at module
+level without creating a circular import. For backward compatibility they are
+re-exported from :mod:`transformer_engine.pytorch.quantization` and
+:mod:`transformer_engine.pytorch`.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Union
+
+from transformer_engine.common.recipe import Format
+
+__all__ = [
+    "QuantizerRole",
+    "QuantizerRequest",
+    "DelayedScalingRequest",
+]
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class QuantizerRole:
+    """Identity of a tensor slot requesting a quantizer.
+
+    TE modules populate all fields they know about.
+    User factories inspect only the fields they care about.
+
+    .. warning::
+        **EXPERIMENTAL**: QuantizerRole is experimental, still under active development,
+        and the API is subject to change without notice. Use at your own risk.
+
+    Fields
+    ------
+    module_type : str
+        Module type that emits this role, e.g. `"linear"`, `"grouped_linear"`, `"dpa"`.
+        Empty string when not provided.
+    tensor_type : str
+        What tensor is being quantized, in the module's own vocabulary.
+        Linear modules: `"input"`, `"weight"`, `"grad_output"`, etc.
+        DPA: `"qkv"`, `"s"`, etc.
+        Empty string when not provided.
+    name : str
+        Caller-provided module instance name (e.g. set by the training
+        framework), e.g.
+        `"qkv"`, `"proj"`, `"fc1"`, `"fc2"`, `"linear_39"`.
+        Empty string when not provided.
+    """
+
+    module_type: str = ""
+    tensor_type: str = ""
+    name: str = ""
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        parts = []
+        if self.module_type:
+            parts.append(f"module_type={self.module_type}")
+        if self.tensor_type:
+            parts.append(f"tensor_type={self.tensor_type}")
+        if self.name:
+            parts.append(f"name={self.name}")
+        return "|".join(parts) if parts else "QuantizerRole()"
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class QuantizerRequest:
+    """Base class for stateful quantizer requests.
+
+    Custom recipe factories return ``QuantizerRequest`` subclasses (instead of
+    quantizer instances) when the quantizer requires TE-managed shared state.
+    TE detects these requests, allocates the required state, and replaces them
+    with real quantizer instances.
+
+    .. warning::
+        **EXPERIMENTAL**: QuantizerRequest is experimental, still under active
+        development, and the API is subject to change without notice.
+    """
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DelayedScalingRequest(QuantizerRequest):
+    """Request a Float8Quantizer with TE-managed delayed scaling state.
+
+    .. warning::
+        **EXPERIMENTAL**: DelayedScalingRequest is experimental, still under active
+        development, and the API is subject to change without notice.
+
+    All ``DelayedScalingRequest`` instances within the same ``CustomRecipeState``
+    must share identical parameter values.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    fp8_format : Format, default = Format.HYBRID
+        Controls fwd/bwd dtype (HYBRID = E4M3 fwd, E5M2 bwd).
+    margin : int, default = 0
+        Margin for scaling factor computation.
+    amax_history_len : int, default = 1024
+        Length of the amax history window.
+    amax_compute_algo : str or Callable, default = "max"
+        Algorithm for choosing amax from history.
+    scaling_factor_compute_algo : Callable or None, default = None
+        Custom scaling factor computation.
+    reduce_amax : bool, default = True
+        Whether to all-reduce amax across the distributed group.
+    """
+
+    fp8_format: Format = Format.HYBRID
+    margin: int = 0
+    amax_history_len: int = 1024
+    amax_compute_algo: Union[str, Callable] = "max"
+    scaling_factor_compute_algo: Optional[Callable] = None
+    reduce_amax: bool = True
